source: for N in a b; do echo "$N"; break; echo NEVER; done
for N in a b; do echo "$N"; continue; echo NEVER; done
for N in a b; do break 1; done; echo "$N"
for N in a b; do continue 1; done; echo "$N"
for N in a b; do false && break; echo "$N"; done
for N in a b; do true || continue; echo "$N"; done
for N in a b; do false || continue; echo NEVER; done
for N in a b; do break && echo NEVER; done; echo $?
while true; do break; echo NEVER; done
until false; do break; echo NEVER; done
N=aa; while test -n "$N"; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; continue; echo NEVER; done
N=aa; until test -z "$N"; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; continue; echo NEVER; done
! while true; do break; done
! until false; do break; done
N=a; while test -n "$N"; do N=; continue; done; echo $?
while false; do break; done; echo $?
until true; do continue; done; echo $?
C=break; for N in a b; do "$C"; done; echo "$N"
C=continue; for N in a b; do "$C"; done; echo "$N"
for N in a b; do false; break; done; echo $?
while true; do ! break; done
N=a; while test -n "$N"; do N=; ! continue; done
for N in a b c; do echo "$N"; test "$N" = b && break; done; echo "$N"
for N in a b c; do test "$N" = b && continue; echo "$N"; done
for N in a b c; do test "$N" = c && break; echo "$N"; done; echo "$N"
N=aaa; while true; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; test "$N" = a && break; done
N=aaa; until false; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; test "$N" = a && break; done
V="a b"; for N in $V; do echo "$N"; V=x; continue; done
N=aaaaaaaaaaaa; while test -n "$N"; do N=${N#a}; continue; done; echo "$N" "$?"
